code_review.project_type: web application — FastAPI backend + Vite/React SPA frontend (monorepo, AI-pattern demo gallery)

existing_self_description.text: Built with Spec4 (BWS4) is a living showcase of common AI application patterns, presented as a collection of small, self-contained example apps behind a single landing page. Each example — starting with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and tool-use via web search — demonstrates one pattern end-to-end: how it's built, what it depends on, and how it behaves, so that visitors unfamiliar with the underlying technique can understand it by seeing it work rather than by reading about it abstractly.

architecture.summary: The backend is a layered FastAPI app with thin route handlers (api/), cross-cutting config/logging/observability (core/), SQLAlchemy models and Alembic migrations (db/), and two example-app pipelines (rag/, tools/) that both draw on a shared services/ layer (generation, embedding, storage, web search, model registry). The frontend mirrors this with per-example lazy-loaded route modules, shared components, typed API hooks, and route-level screens.
architecture.pattern: layered service architecture with shared-framework-services core; route-based code-split frontend
architecture.inferred_from: backend/app/ directory structure and frontend/src/apps/ + frontend/src/routes.tsx

directory_map.role: RAG pipeline: chunking, retrieval, citations, dataset, prompts
Shared framework services: generation, embedding, storage, web search, model registry
Tool-use example app: agent orchestration, prompts
Typed API client + React Query hooks
Shared UI: nav bar/menu, layout shell, theme toggle

env_vars.purpose: LLM provider auth for generation/tool-calling chains

env_vars.name: CORS_ORIGIN
env_vars.purpose: Restricts backend CORS to the deployed web client's single origin

env_vars.name: SENTRY_DSN
env_vars.purpose: Backend error tracking / observability (no-ops if unset)

api_surface.summary: Answers a question via RAG and persists a RagInteraction

ui_summary.styling: Tailwind CSS utility classes + index.css, with light/dark theming persisted to localStorage
ui_summary.routing: React Router (frontend/src/routes.tsx), route-based code-splitting per example app

test_coverage.coverage_summary: Backend tests (13 modules) cover the RAG pipeline (chunking, citations, retrieval, generation), the tool-use agent, model registry, health check, observability, and usage-limit windows; core/config.py wiring and Alembic migrations aren't directly exercised. Frontend tests (8 files, vitest) cover health, landing, nav bar/menu, theme toggle, pattern summary, and both example apps (rag, tooluse).

change_risks.risk: Free-tier LLM model chains rot over time as providers retire free slugs, explicitly acknowledged in README.md
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Periodically verify OpenRouter/Groq free-tier model slugs are still live before relying on generation/tool-calling phases

other_notes: .env.example present at repo root, documenting required variables for both backend and frontend
.python-version file present, consistent with pyproject.toml's >=3.12 requirement
Secondary frontend test command: `npm test` (vitest run) in frontend/
Backend has no separate build step; `uv sync` installs dependencies (no compiled artifact)
Render build step pre-downloads the sentence-transformers embedding model (~88MB) into HF_HOME at build time to avoid Hugging Face rate limits on cold start (render.yaml)
Prompts are explicitly versioned as files (backend/app/rag/prompts/answer_v1.md, answer_v2.md), loaded via prompt_loader.py
Governance/contribution docs present: CLA.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CLAUDE.md (contents not sampled)
Google-style docstrings are an enforced convention per in-code comments, e.g. 'Google-style docstring per project convention.' in backend/app/api/health.py and rag.py
